events.title: The Investigation Begins
events.summary: “Follow the rules to survive. Break them to come home.”Paraxima is an asymmetric co-op psychological horror built on a foundation of methodical investigation. Our goal is to create a high-tension environment where mission success hinges on your ability to observe, identify, and contain the Entity - if you can survive the threat that long.
